message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime(s) from list.

Facts: Stone (石某) went to hotel front desk, pretended to book a room, chatted, then under pretext asked staff to fetch water, while staff distracted, he stole cash of 9400 yuan from front desk. This is theft (盗窃). Possibly also "抢夺"? No, robbery involves use of force or threat. He used deception and took cash when staff not watching; that's theft. So label: 盗窃.

Check list: "盗窃" is present. No other crimes like "诈骗" (no deception for money), "抢夺" (force). So single.

Thus answer: [罪名]盗窃<eoa>
